requiredBehavior: Treat non-spaghetti UI structure as a strict implementation/review requirement for the changed scope, not an optional polish item.

The initiating caller provides legitimate differences such as content, title, size constraints, anchor and alignment through a clear shared interface. Preserve semantic surface kind/modal behavior where necessary.

Common presentation mechanism owns reusable behavior; it must not branch on caller/panel names or reach into feature private state. Caller-owned content/state and command authority remain with their owners.

No copied listener trees, cross-module DOM/private-state mutation, location-only CSS overrides or ad-hoc selector chains substituting for the shared interface. Avoid moving duplicated spaghetti into a single oversized catch-all helper.

Only introduce options required by real current consumers; future differences can be added when justified. Existing inherited implementation outside actual repair impact is not retroactively a full app rewrite.
reviewRequirement: Require source-level evidence of a small cohesive common interface and actual caller-configured reuse, plus independent instance cleanup and behavioral checks. Visual similarity alone cannot PASS this requirement.
routing: Ongoing message to same original writer, include in fresh re-review packet. No additional writer/task or retry reset.
